reviewers.summary: The App focus-refresh test uses a replacement scene component, so it cannot verify the required production scene-builder behavior. The supplied diff also contains conflict markers, but those are within the stated CI boundary.

findingList.message: The test does not prove the first acceptance criterion: it replaces the production scene even though the criterion requires the default lazy loader and existing loadHangarScene path.

evidence.codePathTraced: The App test passes a custom ProductionScene through hangarLazyLoader, replacing the default lazy loader and the production loadHangarScene path named in the first acceptance criterion.
evidence.failureScenario: If the production scene builder fails to receive or render the refreshed server scene, this test can still pass because its replacement component renders the label directly from props.

reviewers.summary: The App focus-refresh test does not meet the acceptance criteria requiring the default lazy loader and production scene builder. A broken production scene path could pass this test.

findingList.message: The App focus-refresh test bypasses the required production scene path. Use App’s default lazy loader and assert the rendered production label and panel against the injected client text.

evidence.codePathTraced: The named App test passes `hangarLazyLoader={() => ProductionScene}`. That replacement component reads `sceneData` and renders its own label, bypassing App’s default lazy loader, `loadHangarScene`, and the production scene builder. It also retains the test-component assertion the acceptance criteria says to replace.
evidence.failureScenario: If the production scene builder ignores the refreshed server scene or renders injected client text, this test can still pass because the replacement component renders the refreshed prop itself. The test therefore does not prove the required production label and panel behavior.

reviewers.summary: The change adds no separate reachable security vulnerability in the reviewed production code. The named App test does not exercise the production scene path required by the acceptance criterion.

findingList.message: The first acceptance criterion is not proved through the required production startup and scene-builder path; the test replaces that path with a custom component.

evidence.codePathTraced: The named App focus-refresh test supplies `hangarLazyLoader={() => ProductionScene}`, replacing the default lazy loader and `loadHangarScene` production path required by the criterion.
evidence.failureScenario: If the production scene builder fails to receive or render the refreshed server view, this test can still pass because its replacement component renders text directly from props.
